title: Welcome to Interactive Guides
description: Learn how Interactive Guides works, how lessons are structured, and how to get the most out of your learning journey.
content:
Welcome

Interactive Guides transforms passive reading into active learning. Each lesson includes interactive elements, knowledge checks, and hands-on examples.

title: How Lessons Work
description: Understand the anatomy of a lesson — content sections, interactive widgets, quizzes, and progress tracking.
content:
Lesson Structure

Every lesson follows a consistent structure: an introduction, core content with interactive examples, a summary, and an optional quiz.

title: Setting Learning Goals
description: Learn how to set effective learning goals, build a study habit, and track your progress over time.
content:
Why Goals Matter

Setting clear, achievable goals is the foundation of effective learning. Use the SMART framework: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound.

title: HTML Document Structure
description: Learn the anatomy of an HTML document — doctype, head, body, and semantic elements that give your pages meaning.
content:
The HTML Document

Every HTML page starts with a doctype declaration, followed by html, head, and body elements. The head contains metadata, while the body holds visible content.

title: CSS Selectors and Specificity
description: Master CSS selectors — element, class, ID, attribute, and pseudo-class selectors — and understand how specificity determines which rules win.
content:
CSS Selectors

Selectors determine which elements your styles apply to. Specificity is the algorithm CSS uses to decide which rule wins when multiple rules target the same element.

title: Flexbox and Grid Layout
description: Learn modern CSS layout systems — Flexbox for one-dimensional layouts and Grid for two-dimensional layouts.
content:
Modern CSS Layout

Flexbox handles one-dimensional layouts (rows or columns), while Grid handles two-dimensional layouts (rows and columns simultaneously).

title: Responsive Design Fundamentals
description: Understand responsive design principles — mobile-first thinking, breakpoints, fluid typography, and the viewport meta tag.
content:
Responsive Design

Responsive design ensures your site works on all screen sizes. Start with mobile styles and progressively enhance for larger screens using media queries.

title: Variables and Data Types
description: Learn JavaScript variables — let, const, var — and the primitive data types: string, number, boolean, null, undefined, and symbol.
content:
Variables in JavaScript

Use const by default, let when reassignment is needed, and avoid var. JavaScript has 7 primitive types and the object type.

title: Functions and Arrow Syntax
description: Understand JavaScript functions — declarations, expressions, arrow functions, closures, and higher-order functions.
content:
Functions

Functions are first-class objects in JavaScript. Arrow functions provide concise syntax and lexical this binding.

title: Async JavaScript: Promises and Async/Await
description: Master asynchronous JavaScript — callbacks, Promises, async/await, and handling errors in async code.
content:
Async JavaScript

Promises represent a value that may not be available yet. Async/await is syntactic sugar over Promises that makes async code look synchronous.

title: ES Modules and Import/Export
description: Learn the ES module system — named exports, default exports, dynamic imports, and tree-shaking.
content:
ES Modules

ES modules are the standard module system for JavaScript. Use named exports for multiple values and default export for a single value per module.

title: The Event Loop and Concurrency
description: Understand how JavaScript's single-threaded event loop works — the call stack, task queue, microtask queue, and how async code is scheduled.
content:
The Event Loop

JavaScript is single-threaded but handles concurrency via the event loop. The call stack processes synchronous code, while tasks and microtasks are queued for later execution.

title: React Components and JSX
description: Learn the building blocks of React — function components, JSX syntax, props, and how components compose together.
content:
React Components

Components are reusable, self-contained pieces of UI. JSX is a syntax extension that lets you write HTML-like code in JavaScript.

title: State and Hooks: useState and useEffect
description: Master the two most essential React hooks — useState for state management and useEffect for side effects.
content:
React Hooks

useState manages local component state. useEffect handles side effects like data fetching, subscriptions, and DOM manipulation.

title: Component Composition Patterns
description: Learn advanced composition patterns — render props, compound components, context sharing, and when to use each.
content:
Composition Patterns

Composition is React's most powerful pattern. Compound components, render props, and context let you build flexible, reusable component APIs.

title: React Performance Optimization
description: Learn how to identify and fix React performance issues — memoization, virtual lists, code splitting, and avoiding unnecessary re-renders.
content:
Performance in React

React is fast by default, but large apps can develop bottlenecks. Use React.memo, useMemo, and useCallback strategically — not indiscriminately.

title: Color Theory for Developers
description: Understand color theory basics — the color wheel, complementary and analogous schemes, and how to build accessible color palettes.
content:
Color Theory

Understanding color relationships helps you create harmonious palettes. Use HSL for easier manipulation and always check contrast ratios for accessibility.

title: Typography and Readability
description: Learn typographic principles — font pairing, line height, font sizing scales, and how typography affects readability and hierarchy.
content:
Typography

Good typography guides the reader's eye. Use a modular scale for font sizes, 1.5 line height for body text, and limit yourself to 2-3 font families.

title: Spacing Systems and Visual Rhythm
description: Master spacing in UI design — 8px base grids, consistent spacing scales, and how spacing creates visual hierarchy and rhythm.
content:
Spacing Systems

Consistent spacing creates visual rhythm. An 8px base grid is the industry standard — it divides evenly and works across most screen sizes.

title: Getting Started with Vite
description: Learn how Vite transforms modern web development — instant server start, hot module replacement, and optimized builds.
content:
Vite

Vite uses native ES modules for dev and Rollup for production builds. It offers instant cold starts and lightning-fast HMR.

title: Git Workflow Essentials
description: Master the Git workflow — branching, committing, merging, rebasing, and resolving conflicts with conventional commits.
content:
Git Workflow

Git is essential for collaborative development. Use feature branches, write clear commit messages, and keep your history clean with interactive rebase.

title: TypeScript Configuration Best Practices
description: Configure TypeScript for safety and productivity — strict mode, path aliases, project references, and useful compiler flags.
content:
TypeScript Configuration

Enable strict mode from day one. It catches bugs early and forces better code quality. Use path aliases to avoid deep relative imports.

title: Writing Your First Tests with Vitest
description: Learn how to write and run unit tests with Vitest — describe, it, expect, and testing async code.
content:
Testing with Vitest

Vitest is a fast, modern test runner with a Jest-compatible API. Start with simple assertions and build up to testing components with React Testing Library.

title: Debugging Strategies for Frontend
description: Learn systematic debugging strategies — browser DevTools, breakpoints, network inspection, and isolating bugs with binary search.
content:
Debugging Strategies

Effective debugging is systematic: reproduce the bug, isolate the cause, fix the root issue, and verify the fix. Browser DevTools are your most powerful tool.

title: Code Review Best Practices
description: Learn how to give and receive effective code reviews — what to look for, how to frame feedback, and building a culture of quality.
content:
Code Reviews

Good code reviews improve code quality and share knowledge. Review for correctness, readability, and security. Be kind but thorough in feedback.

title: Understanding XSS and Content Security
description: Learn about Cross-Site Scripting attacks — how they work, how to prevent them, and how to use Content Security Policy headers.
content:
XSS Prevention

Cross-Site Scripting occurs when untrusted data is inserted into a page without sanitization. Always escape user input and use a Content Security Policy.

title: Secure Data Handling in the Browser
description: Understand how to handle sensitive data in frontend applications — token storage, HTTPS, and avoiding common pitfalls.
content:
Secure Data Handling

Never store sensitive tokens in localStorage where JavaScript can access them. Use HttpOnly cookies for session tokens and always serve over HTTPS.

title: REST API Fundamentals
description: Learn REST API principles — HTTP methods, status codes, resource naming, and how to design a clean RESTful API.
content:
REST APIs

REST uses HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) on resource URLs. Use proper status codes and keep your API stateless for scalability.

title: Fetching Data in Modern JavaScript
description: Master data fetching — the Fetch API, handling errors, loading states, and patterns for React applications.
content:
Data Fetching

The Fetch API is the modern way to make HTTP requests in JavaScript. Always handle loading, error, and success states. In React, use AbortController to cancel stale requests.

title: Client-Side Caching Strategies
description: Learn how to cache data on the client — cache-first, network-first, and stale-while-revalidate patterns for fast, responsive apps.
content:
Caching Strategies

Caching reduces network requests and improves perceived performance. Choose cache-first for static data, network-first for fresh data, and stale-while-revalidate for a balance.
